How It Works

Our AI agent follows a multi-step intelligent workflow

1

Data Ingestion

Collect customer support records from Snowflake, CSV or the sample dataset.

2

AI Analysis

The Ticket Analyzer skill reads each record and extracts category, sentiment and urgency.

3

Anomaly Detection

The Risk Detector skill flags unusual patterns and scores each ticket's risk.

4

Decision & Action

The Decision Agent branches on risk level and triggers the right contextual action.

5

Report & Insights

A business report and AI insights are generated automatically at the end of the run.
